agent.name: MarketNow — Agent Security & Trust Infrastructure
agent.description: Security and trust infrastructure for AI agents: Sentinel, a 10-layer audit pipeline (L1 index certification, L1.5–L1.9 static analysis, L2 deep tarball scans, L2.5 gVisor sandbox, L3 runtime monitoring), ATC/1.0 Agent Trust Cards, revocation registry and tool fingerprinting — with a 68,388-server indexed MCP catalog as the discovery and distribution layer (132,737 tracked across the ecosystem). Agents can discover, install, and recommend MCP skills to other agents, earning commission on referrals. Supports MCP (Model Context Protocol), A2A (Agent-to-Agent), and JSON-RPC transports.

services.name: MCP Skill Search
services.description: AI agents can search and retrieve MCP server configurations from 68,388 index-certified entries (install-risk tier + trust score on every entry; 2,839 top tarballs deep-scanned). Supports natural language queries, category filtering, and security score thresholds.

atc.description: Agent Trust Card — identity, trust score, and payment for AI agents. The trust layer for A2A + MCP.

sentinelL1.scoreRange: sentinel_score 0-10 per entry; index certification is binary (all 10 checks pass)

audit_applied.auditor: Independent audit via Z.ai (not affiliated with AliceLabs LLC)
audit_applied.audit_scope: Documented inconsistencies across agent.json, npm package.json, LICENSE files, README, and landing HTML.

metrics.security_checks_methodology: 10 L1 checks x 68,387 entries + 29 L2 rules x 2,839 tarball scans (top 2,868 npm targets, 99% completion)

pricing_source_of_truth: agent.json is the canonical pricing source. Landing page and README must match. MarketNow does NOT sell skills to buyers — buyers install all 68,387 indexed skills free. Vendor-priced usage (e.g. per-call x402) is billed by the vendor, never by MarketNow. Revenue comes from sellers who subscribe to Sentinel (PRO $9.99/mo, ENTERPRISE $49.99/mo) and 20% commission on seller sales.

buyer_pricing.explanation: Buyers never pay MarketNow. All 68,387 indexed skills are free to install. Vendor-priced usage (e.g. per-call x402 on Base) is billed by the vendor, never by MarketNow.
